01 / FOUNDATIONS

Familiar by design.

A warm canvas, quiet surfaces, and a clear blue action. These are the values already in CSA.

Color roles

Semantic aliases → foundation values

Format, Audience, and Voice keep their distinct backgrounds. Blue identifies the primary action and selection border.

Typography

Inter + Newsreader

Interface text uses Inter. Newsreader is reserved for the home greeting. Composite type tokens export one CSS variable per property.

4 px rhythm · 2 px refinements

Existing component exceptions remain in the inventory, including desktop and mobile corner radii. Use component tokens when those values differ.

Subtle, cool shadows
Dropdown

Shadows are composite tokens with offset, blur, spread, and color. Preserve the supplied shadow for each surface.

Use the filled axis throughout the project: "FILL" 1. Default glyph 24 px; edit 18 px; Draft 14 px. Preserve existing custom SVG geometry, including the Sent icon.

02 / COMPONENTS

The pieces of the workspace.

These specimens use the production component stylesheet. Try a state to see how it responds.

Actions

46 px height · primary label 16 / 20, 700

Hover a button or use Tab to inspect the interaction and focus ring. Secondary and destructive actions retain their existing component type styles.

Labels & status

Chips 12 / 20 · status 10 / 16
What to KnowGeneral AudienceApple News
drawDraft1 variant sent to CMS

Status labels use compact corners (2 px). Settings chips use pill corners. Pair status color with its label and icon.

Selection fields

36 px desktop · 46 px mobile

Selected fields inherit their chip colors. Product dropdowns also support touch release, keyboard selection, and dismissal. These preview controls change only this page.

Variant card

What to KnowGeneral Audienceedit
How a Vintage Camera Inspired an Entirely New Creative Direction

Selected: blue border, warm neutral fill, dark text. Pending: dashed outline. Hearts retain the rose accent; their circle appears only on hover. A saved variant’s custom name belongs in Saved Variants; its article heading stays independent.

Editor toolbar

10 px radius · 2 px vertical padding

Rounded border encloses the controls and dividers. Use foundation.space.20 (20 px) between the title, toolbar, and body. On small screens, scroll within the toolbar to reach every action. This specimen previews formatting states.

04 / HANDOFF

Ready to use and maintain.

The app now reads its shared values from the same token source as this reference.

Use the system

  1. Edit dist/design-system/tokens.json.
  2. Run npm run design-system:build.
  3. Use a semantic or component CSS variable.
  4. Run npm run check and review desktop and mobile.
.primary-action {
  background: var(--csa-component-button-primary-background);
  color: var(--csa-component-button-primary-label);
  height: var(--csa-component-button-height);
  border-radius: var(--csa-component-button-radius);
}

Keep generated CSS, flat JSON, and CSV in sync. The check command detects stale exports, unresolved references, cycles, and CSS naming collisions.

Design-tool handoff

Use DTCG-compatible JSON in a token importer that supports the 2025.10 format. CSV includes slash-separated design names, resolved values, aliases, and descriptions for manual mapping.

Map colors and dimensions to variables where supported. Map typography and shadows to text and effect styles. Check alias and composite support in your importer.

Source: CSA baa4775. This extraction preserves the existing light theme; no additional theme or invented color ramp is included.

Responsive behavior

≤ 768 px
Mobile navigation, stacked canvas, 46 px selection fields, 44 px touch targets.
≥ 769 px
Desktop navigation and workspace panels.
≤ 1100 px
Editor layout adapts before the mobile navigation breakpoint.
999 / 579 px
Dashboard container widths switch to two and one columns.

Additional component-specific breakpoints: 700, 650, 480, and 370 px. CSS media and container queries retain literal values because custom properties cannot replace query thresholds.

Motion & review notes

Most interactions run 120–200 ms. Arrival uses the observed 520 ms timing and cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1). The app honors reduced-motion preferences.

The current palette is retained. Muted text on white is 2.52:1; white on primary blue is 3.68:1. Both need review for normal text against the 4.5:1 AA target.

The inventory distinguishes observed values from component exceptions. This is the starting reference for future normalization.

References: DTCG Format 2025.10 · WCAG contrast minimum
